# 身份验证和数据 {#authentication-and-data}

Shopify 归入“身份验证和数据”的 API，以及只有它们使用的类型。本页：[`AppApi`](#appapi)、[`AppBridgeConfig`](#appbridgeconfig)、[`EnvironmentApi`](#environmentapi)、[`IdTokenApi`](#idtokenapi)、[`Scopes`](#scopes)、[`UserApi`](#userapi)。

## `AppApi` {#appapi}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `extensions()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="#extensioninfo">ExtensionInfo</a>[]&gt;</code> | The list of extensions from the current app. |

用于： [useAppBridge()](/zh/app-bridge/use-app-bridge), [`ShopifyGlobal`](/zh/app-bridge/types/#shopifyglobal)

### `ExtensionInfo` {#extensioninfo}

类型参数： <code v-pre>Type extends <a href="#extensiontype">ExtensionType</a> = <a href="#extensiontype">ExtensionType</a></code>

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `handle` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The unique identifier for the extension. |
| `activations` | <code v-pre>Type extends "ui_extension" ? <a href="#uiextensionactivation">UiExtensionActivation</a>[] : Type extends "theme_app_extension" ? <a href="#themeextensionactivation">ThemeExtensionActivation</a>[] : never</code> | List of activation records for the extension. The shape depends on the extension type:<br>- UI extensions have activations with only `target`<br>- Theme app extensions have nested activations representing blocks/embeds |
| `type` | <code v-pre>Type</code> | The type of the extension. |

用于： [`AppApi`](#appapi)

### `ExtensionType` {#extensiontype}

```ts
type ExtensionType = "ui_extension" | "theme_app_extension";
```

用于： [`ExtensionInfo`](#extensioninfo)

### `ThemeExtensionActivation` {#themeextensionactivation}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | <code v-pre><a href="#themeappblocktarget">ThemeAppBlockTarget</a> &#124; <a href="#themeappembedtarget">ThemeAppEmbedTarget</a></code> | The target location type for this block/embed.<br>- `section` for blocks<br>- `head`, `body`, or `compliance_head` for embeds |
| `handle` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The filename of the block/embed within the theme app extension (without extension). This is configured by the developer when creating the block file. |
| `name` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The developer-configured display name of this block/embed, defined in the block's schema. 参见： [https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/online-store/theme-app-extensions/configuration#schema](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/online-store/theme-app-extensions/configuration#schema) |
| `status` | <code v-pre><a href="#activationstatus">ActivationStatus</a></code> | The availability status of this block/embed. |
| `activations` | <code v-pre><a href="#themeappblockactivation">ThemeAppBlockActivation</a>[]</code> | List of theme-specific activations for this block/embed. Contains where the block is actually placed within themes. |

用于： [`ExtensionInfo`](#extensioninfo)

### `UiExtensionActivation` {#uiextensionactivation}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The target identifier for the extension activation. For example, `purchase.thank-you.block.render`. |

用于： [`ExtensionInfo`](#extensioninfo)

### `ActivationStatus` {#activationstatus}

```ts
type ActivationStatus = "active" | "available" | "unavailable";
```

用于： [`ThemeExtensionActivation`](#themeextensionactivation)

### `ThemeAppBlockActivation` {#themeappblockactivation}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The target identifier for the block/embed placement within the theme. For example, `template--product.alternate/main/my_app_product_rating_GPzUYy`. |
| `themeId` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The theme ID where this block/embed is activated. Format: `gid://shopify/OnlineStoreTheme/{id}` |

用于： [`ThemeExtensionActivation`](#themeextensionactivation)

### `ThemeAppBlockTarget` {#themeappblocktarget}

```ts

```

用于： [`ThemeExtensionActivation`](#themeextensionactivation)

```ts

```

用于： [`ThemeExtensionActivation`](#themeextensionactivation)

## `AppBridgeConfig` {#appbridgeconfig}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The client ID (also known as the API key) for your application, found in the Shopify Partner Dashboard under your app's settings.<br><br>You must provide this value using a `<meta name="shopify-api-key">` tag. |
| `appOrigins?` | <code v-pre>string[]</code> | An allowlist of origins that your app can send authenticated fetch requests to.<br><br>Set this property if your app needs to make authenticated requests to a domain other than your app's origin. Requests to your app's own domain (and its subdomains) are automatically allowed.<br><br>Each value must be an origin in the format `scheme://hostname` or `scheme://hostname:port` (for example, `'https://example.com'` or `'https://example.com:8443'`). |
| `debug?` | <code v-pre><a href="#debugoptions">DebugOptions</a></code> | Configuration for enabling Web Vitals performance logging.<br><br>Use this property during development for identifying performance issues. |
| `disabledFeatures?` | <code v-pre>string[]</code> | An array of App Bridge feature names to disable in your app.<br><br>Supported values:<br>- `'fetch'` — Disables App Bridge's automatic fetch interceptor, which adds authentication headers to requests to the Shopify Admin API.<br>- `'auto-redirect'` — Disables automatic redirection when the app is loaded outside of the Shopify Admin. |
| `experimentalFeatures?` | <code v-pre>string[]</code> | The experimental features to enable in your app.<br><br>This allows app developers to opt-in to experiement features. |
| `host?` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The base64-encoded host of the shop that's embedding your app. When decoded, the value has the format `admin.shopify.com/store/{shop-name}`.<br><br>This property is automatically set by the host environment. |
| `locale?` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The locale of the admin user viewing your app, as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (for example, `'en-US'`, `'fr-FR'`, `'ja-JP'`).<br><br>This reflects the language the merchant has chosen for the Shopify admin, not the shop's customer-facing locale.<br><br>This property is automatically set by the host environment. 默认值： `'en-US'` |
| `shop?` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The permanent `.myshopify.com` domain of the shop that's embedding your app (for example, `'my-store.myshopify.com'`). This is always the Shopify-assigned domain, not a custom domain.<br><br>This property is automatically set by the host environment. |

用于： [useAppBridge()](/zh/app-bridge/use-app-bridge), [`ShopifyGlobal`](/zh/app-bridge/types/#shopifyglobal)

### `DebugOptions` {#debugoptions}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `webVitals?` | <code v-pre>boolean</code> | Enables or disables the logging of web performance metrics (Web Vitals) in the browser's console.<br><br>When set to `true`, the app will log Core Web Vitals (such as LCP, INP, and CLS) and other relevant performance metrics to help developers understand the real-world performance of their app. This can be useful for debugging performance issues during development or in a staging environment.<br><br>This field is optional and defaults to `false`, meaning that web vitals logging is disabled by default to avoid performance overhead and unnecessary console output in production environments. 默认值： `false` |

用于： [`AppBridgeConfig`](#appbridgeconfig)

## `Scopes` {#scopes}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="#scopesdetail">ScopesDetail</a>&gt;</code> | Returns the current access scopes for this app on this shop, including which are granted, required, and optional. |
| `request` | <code v-pre>(scopes: <a href="#scope">Scope</a>[]) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="#scopesrequestresponse">ScopesRequestResponse</a>&gt;</code> | Opens a permission grant modal asking the merchant to grant the specified scopes.<br><br>The scopes must be [access scope](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/access-scopes) handles (for example, `'read_products'` or `'write_orders'`) that are declared as optional in your app configuration.<br><br>See the [permission grant modal](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/authentication-authorization/app-installation/manage-access-scopes#request-access-scopes-using-the-app-bridge-api-for-embedded-apps) documentation for more details. |
| `revoke` | <code v-pre>(scopes: <a href="#scope">Scope</a>[]) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="#scopesrevokeresponse">ScopesRevokeResponse</a>&gt;</code> | Revokes the specified optional scopes from this app on this shop.<br><br>The scopes must be [access scope](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/access-scopes) handles (for example, `'read_products'` or `'write_orders'`) that are currently granted and declared as optional. Required scopes cannot be revoked. |

用于： [useAppBridge()](/zh/app-bridge/use-app-bridge), [`ShopifyGlobal`](/zh/app-bridge/types/#shopifyglobal)

### `Scope` {#scope}

```ts
type Scope = string;
```

用于： [`Scopes`](#scopes), [`ScopesDetail`](#scopesdetail)

### `ScopesDetail` {#scopesdetail}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `granted` | <code v-pre><a href="#scope">Scope</a>[]</code> | The scopes currently granted to this app on this shop. This includes both required and optional scopes. |
| `required` | <code v-pre><a href="#scope">Scope</a>[]</code> | The scopes declared as required in your app configuration. These are always granted at install time and cannot be revoked by the app. |
| `optional` | <code v-pre><a href="#scope">Scope</a>[]</code> | The scopes declared as optional in your app configuration. These may or may not be currently granted — check `granted` to see which are active. |

用于： [`Scopes`](#scopes), [`ScopesRequestResponse`](#scopesrequestresponse), [`ScopesRevokeResponse`](#scopesrevokeresponse)

### `ScopesRequestResponse` {#scopesrequestresponse}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `result` | <code v-pre><a href="#userresult">UserResult</a></code> | The merchant's response: `'granted-all'` if they accepted all requested scopes, or `'declined-all'` if they declined. |
| `detail` | <code v-pre><a href="#scopesdetail">ScopesDetail</a></code> | The updated scopes for this app on this shop after the merchant's response. |

用于： [`Scopes`](#scopes)

### `ScopesRevokeResponse` {#scopesrevokeresponse}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `detail` | <code v-pre><a href="#scopesdetail">ScopesDetail</a></code> | The updated scopes for this app on this shop after the revocation. |

用于： [`Scopes`](#scopes)

### `UserResult` {#userresult}

```ts
type UserResult = "granted-all" | "declined-all";
```

用于： [`ScopesRequestResponse`](#scopesrequestresponse)
